'''R3-Q5''' was the designation given to a series of [[R3-series astromech droid/Legends|R3-series]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] in service to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] shortly before the [[Declaration of Rebellion/Legends|onset]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were employed by the Empire at various facilities, including a [[TIE Fighter Construction Facility|TIE fighter factory]] and the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]]. [[Galen Marek]], [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] to [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], encountered several on his missions to these locales.

==Description==
A series of [[Class two droid/Legends|second-degree]]<ref name="TNEGTD" /> [[R3-series astromech droid/Legends|R3-series]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]], R3-Q5 [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were mostly plated in [[Color/Legends|black]], with some [[Bronze/Legends|bronze]] panels, and featured black [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]].<ref name="TFU" />

==History==
Around [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]],<ref name="TFUC">The framing story of the [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' graphic novel]] is dated to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. According to the [[Star Wars comic books|graphic novel's]] narrative, [[Galen Marek|Starkiller's]] [[Death/Legends|death]] was staged by his [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] a full year prior to the events depicted in the framing story. The appearance of R3-Q5 units at the [[TIE Fighter Construction Facility|TIE fighter factory]] over [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in the [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' video game]] takes place prior to Starkiller's staged death. Therefore, the droids' appearance in the game must take place around [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]].</ref> R3-Q5 units were employed in various [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] installations, such as a [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar]] [[TIE Fighter Construction Facility|TIE fighter factory]] over the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], a large [[ore cannon]]-equipped [[Imperial Ore Facility|facility]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]], and the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] known as the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were present when the infamous [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Galen Marek]] was active at these locations prior to the [[Declaration of Rebellion/Legends|dawn]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="TFU" />

==Behind the scenes==
R3-Q5 appears in the [[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]], [[Wikipedia:Personal computer|PC]] and [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]] versions of the [[2008]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''. Several of the droids appear during the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]] [[Factory/Legends|Factory]], Imperial Raxus Prime and [[Death/Legends|Death]] [[Star/Legends|Star]] levels. The droid appears in the kills list, if any are destroyed during gameplay, following completion of these levels. Despite the fact that the droids are harmless, they can be destroyed if the player uses [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] or [[The Force/Legends|Force]] attacks on them.<ref name="TFU" /> The [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed: Prima Official Game Guide|Prima strategy guide]] states that the droids can be used to practice those techniques.<ref name="TFUGG">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>
